SELECT c.CustomerID FROM customers c JOIN yearmonth y ON c.CustomerID = y.CustomerID WHERE YEAR(y.Date) = 2012 AND c.Country = 'LAM' ORDER BY y.Consumption LIMIT 1

SELECT c.CustomerID 
FROM customers c 
JOIN yearmonth y ON c.CustomerID = y.CustomerID 
WHERE y.Date LIKE '2012%' 
AND c.Currency = 'LAM' 
ORDER BY y.Consumption ASC 
LIMIT 1;
SELECT c.CustomerID FROM customers c INNER JOIN yearmonth y ON c.CustomerID = y.CustomerID WHERE y.Date BETWEEN '2012-01-01' AND '2012-12-31' AND c.Currency = 'LAM' ORDER BY y.Consumption ASC LIMIT 1
SELECT c.CustomerID FROM customers c JOIN yearmonth y ON c.CustomerID = y.CustomerID WHERE y.Date LIKE '2012%' AND c.Country = 'LAM' ORDER BY y.Consumption ASC LIMIT 1

SELECT c.CustomerID, c.Name, ym.Consumption 
FROM customers c 
JOIN yearmonth ym ON c.CustomerID = ym.CustomerID 
WHERE ym.Date LIKE '%2012%' AND c.Segment = 'LAM' 
ORDER BY ym.Consumption ASC 
LIMIT 1
